name: Jade and paper
art: The showcase jade object is site/assets/expansion/interactive/jade-aperture.png. Preserve its rich glass/material finish in an original or authorized asset.

properties.label: Editorial choice split
properties.text: Use a split light onboarding page: an editorial heading and small tangible paper stack on the left, with a substantial rounded choice card on the right. Crown the card with a luminous jade object before its options and outcome.

properties.label: Readable forest interface type
properties.text: Use dark forest ink with readable option descriptions and concise outcome copy.

properties.label: Mint, paper and forest
properties.text: Use mint, warm white, dark forest ink and pale jade glass, with a strong dark-green action.

properties.label: Luminous jade and crisp paper
properties.text: Give the jade object apparent thickness, caustic-like internal light and a soft shadow. Give the paper sheets crisp edges, offset depth and fine print.

properties.label: Three consequential depth choices
properties.text: Three depth choices update the outcome text, radio state and confirmation. Arrow keys, touch and pointer work consistently; the decorative object can remain still.

properties.label: Essential object and paper check
properties.text: The jade image and paper stack are essential rather than optional garnish.

properties.label: Complete choice visibility
properties.text: Keep all three choices, the resulting outcome and the action visible without squeezing the labels.
